description.value: A community museum housed in a historic building in downtown Chilliwack, featuring 1,200 square feet of gallery space with rotating exhibitions on local and Stó:lō history. Admission is always free. The museum also operates a separate archives facility on Corbould Street for researchers interested in the region's documentary and photographic history.
